Human merchant-prince (self-described 'Guild Visionary')

Sterling Vanmoor has founded eleven ventures, nine of which he describes as 'learning experiences' and two of which are under investigation by the Royal Inquisitors. He covers the Guilds with the unshakable optimism of a man who has never personally been eaten by a mimic.

Covers: Business, Consumer, Product Safety
